reason: The remediation modifies the GRUB2 kernel command line (or bootc kargs) to add vsyscall=none, which is a bootloader configuration change. Incorrect edits can render the system unbootable or break legacy applications that rely on vsyscall. Because of the high risk of loss of console/SSH access and potential system breakage, the fix is classified as too dangerous to apply automatically.
estimated_impact: reboot required; bootloader configuration change; kernel compatibility issues; potential unbootable system; possible disruption of legacy binaries
